# DonutSMP Hub

> Community companion site for the DonutSMP Minecraft server. Live player count, rules, store, leaderboards, and Discord community.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://donut-hub.onrender.com/): Live player count, latest blog posts, community Discord, and server overview
- [Rules & Policies](https://donut-hub.onrender.com/rules.html): All 25 DonutSMP server rules with plain English explanations
- [Store](https://donut-hub.onrender.com/store.html): Donut+ ranks and Shards packages with direct checkout links
- [Leaderboards](https://donutschematics.com/players/leaderboard): Community-run player leaderboard for DonutSMP

## About DonutSMP
DonutSMP is a Minecraft survival multiplayer server at donutsmp.net (port 19132) focused on base-hunting and Crystal PvP. It has six Overworld proxies: NA East, NA West, EU Central, EU West, Asia, and Oceania.
